data.body: CLOSED via Gerrit change 1101 (patchset 2, MERGED as 262616961): https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1101 — LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved. Every review workflow's LLM call now rides at the resolved model's MAXIMUM output capacity via the shared review-kernel rule (review_kernel.verify: MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS table + model_max_output_tokens + max_output_cfg; haiku-4-5 64000, sonnet-4-6/opus-4-8 128000, unknown -> DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS). Un-floored calls found beyond plan review and remediated: code-review base/Round-A/Round-B overlay finders (via CodeReviewBatchRunner StepContext input), code-review Pass-2 verify + Pass-4 coach yaml steps, code-review novelty sub-call (score_code_novelty), completion verifier PRIMARY call (_verify_completion_inner cfg floor + completion-verification.yaml verify step), review_ticket (operations.py), plan-review _verifier_cfg consumers (novelty/contradiction/comment-trail xcheck sub-calls). Bounded-recovery output_token_limit clamps untouched. ModelProfile seam (change 1014/f184) not on main and lacks max-output — table mechanism used. Gates at close: lint+typecheck green; tests/unit (workflow 545, non-workflow full suite under -x, incl. code_review + completion recovery suites) green; tests/interfaces/lifecycle 397 green. Tests: tests/unit/workflow/test_review_output_budget.py (23).
